findings.evidence: P1 liquidity-driven market_pair_address and market_pair_side changes created permanent provider disagreements and blocked identity handoff. Correction commit 7f7ab6fd0d0a9b48efd83419d82cae0a71d2fe25 classifies those keys and the sibling market_evidence_provider as refreshable market provenance, clears stale pair provenance only on a fresh provider observation, preserves last-known provenance on unavailable or unrelated observations, normalizes historical pair-selection disagreements, preserves genuine identity conflicts, and stabilizes identity fingerprints; RED before, GREEN after. Registry learning DFF-075/PRH-169.

P2 provider unavailability, duplicate capacity reservation, malformed JSON or an unexpected HTTP-200 payload shape on a later DexScreener batch discarded completed rows and cursor progress. Correction commit 7f7ab6fd0d0a9b48efd83419d82cae0a71d2fe25 validates response shape before capacity success, returns completed rows, processed assets and an explicit error marker for those failures so they are persisted before the failed batch is retried, and allows failed dedup reservations to retry immediately; RED before, GREEN after. Registry learning DFF-064/PRH-170.

P2 transfer acquisition made 612 unmetered RPC calls in one sync with three endpoints. Correction commit 7f7ab6fd0d0a9b48efd83419d82cae0a71d2fe25 installs one config-declared total acquisition allowance around provider checks, transfers, corroboration, retries, failures and swaps; nested swap budgets inherit the same allowance, exhaustion gives explicit partial coverage without checkpoint advancement, and signed swap counts remain per-swap; RED before, GREEN after.
